purpose: Evaluate the already selected, audited boundary102 on six previously unopened matches; not training, development, selection or a replacement for the original country-disjoint final.
user_request: Find additional independent matches and test overfitting, 16 November 2026, after code/test audit.
old_protocol_preserved: These six remain excluded from training and model selection. Their first read is registered as a separate match-held-out audit. Previous plans and results are not relabelled.
models: audited v4 control, identical inherited feature repair
inputs: Raw VISIBLE geometry only; no labels, estimated ball or event fields. Predictions must be saved before reference decoding.
primary_metric: Current pinned official Spell F1 at IoU .3/.4/.5/.6/.7, whole-game equal weight
uncertainty: Descriptive paired whole-match bootstrap, seed 20261116, 10000 replicates; also resample connected components of shared-team graph. Small n and shared provider/team dependence prevent population-level no-overfitting claims.
interpretation: Report all six matches, failures and both scenarios regardless of result. Positive gains support transfer to unseen matches, not universal generalization. Regressions remain visible. No post-test tuning or model switching.
constraints: Old twelve final matches are not reopened
Unusable references count as incomplete audit, never silently dropped
known_limitations: One team in each bridge appeared in PFF train/dev. Same vendor/event-derived references; not a new-provider or wholly unseen-team test. Source identities and hashes will be checked before scoring.
